rows: Indicates whether the supplier is (Yes) or is not (No) active for shopping. If unspecified, supplier will NOT be active for shopping.

Also known as DBA. Use the DoingBusinessAs field to provide a name, other than the legal company name, under which the supplier does business.

Indicates whether the supplier is (Yes) or is not (No) to be included in the TSM supplier export queue. The default setting is Yes.
Supplier's SSN, tax identification number or other federal ID number.

Indicates whether the supplier is to be identified by his or her social security number (SSN) or federal ID (FederalId). Valid only if LegalStructure field is set to IndividualSoleProprietor. If so, then this field is required.
Unique reference number or ID generated by a thirdparty application (that is, in addition to an ERP system) that can be used to map a supplier from SelectSite to the thirdparty application.
Value-added tax (VAT) registration number for the supplier. Must be a valid VAT for the supplier's country of origin.
Website address to which users can go for more information about the supplier.
Year the supplier's business was established, in the following format: yyyy
Current, unique ERP number associated with the supplier. Required.
Indicates the payment type for the account. Required. Must be one of: (DirectDeposit | Check | CreditCard | WireTransfer)
Current, unique ERP Number associated with the account. Required.
Unique reference number or ID generated by a thirdparty application (that is, in addition to an ERP system) that can be used to map an account from SelectSite to the thirdparty application.
Indicates whether the account is (Yes) or is not (No) active.
Currency code for the account. Must be valid ISO 3-digit currency code. Required.
Current, unique ERP number associated with the matching remittance address for the supplier.
Type indicator for associated address. Currently only type "remitto" is supported.

Indicates the tupe of bank account to which payments to the supplier will be made. Required if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit or WireTransfer. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit. Must be one of: (Checking | Savings)

Name of the nank used by the account. Required if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit or WireTransfer. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit.

Name of the bank account holder. Required if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit or WireTransfer. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit.

Indicates whether the bank uses a standard account number (Account Number) or an International Bank Account Number (Iban, which is valid only for countries other than the United States that support IBAN). If the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit, this field is required for all countries other than the United States. Must be blank for the United States. If the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to WireTransfer, this field is required for the countries identified in "AccountNumberType, BankAccountNumber, and InternationalRoutingCode Fields" on page 107. Must be blank for all other countries. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit.

Routing number of the bank. If the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit, this field is always required for the United States, and required for all other countries if the AccountNumberType field is set to AccountNumber. If the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to WireTransfer, this field is required for the United States. Must be blank for all other countries. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit.

Account number of the bank account. If the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit, this field is required for the United States, and required for all other countries if the AccountNumberType field is set to AccountNumber. If the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to WireTransfer, and the AccountNumberType field is set to AccountNumber, this field is required for the United States, and for the countries identified in "AccountNumberType, BankAccountNumber, and InternationalRoutingCode Fields" on page 107. Must be blank for all other countries. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit.

IBAN of the bank account. If the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit, this field is required for all countries except the United States. Must be blank for the United States. If the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to WireTransfer, this field is always required for some countries, and required for other countries if the AccountNumberType field is set to Iban. See "IbanBankAccountNumber Field" on page 109 for the full list of countries for which this field is required. Must be blank for all other countries. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit.

Direct deposit format used by the bank. ACH - Automated Clearing House CCD - ACH Corporate Credit or Debit Entry CTX - ACH corporate trade exchange Valid only if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit, Check, or Credit. Must be one of: (DirectDepositFormat_ACH | DirectDepositFormat_CCD | DirectDepositFormat_CTX)

Also known as BIC. Unique 8-character or 11-digit identifier for the bank. Required if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to WireTransfer. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit, Check, or Credit.

Also known as IRC. Country-specific bank routing code for international banking transactions. If the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to WireTransfer, and the AccountNumberType field is set to AccountNumber, this field is required for the countries identified in "AccountNumberType, BankAccountNumber, and InternationalRoutingCode Fields" on page 107. Must be blank for all other countries. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit, Check, or Credit.

Country associated with the bank account. Required if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit or WireTransfer. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit.

First line of address associated with the bank account. Required if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit or WireTransfer. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit.
Second line of address associated with the bank account. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit.
Third line of address associated with the bank account. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit.

City associated with the bank account. Required if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit or WireTransfer. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit.

State associated with the bank account. For US addresses, 2-letter state code associated with the address. For non-US addresses, name of the province, county, or region associated with the address. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check, Credit, or WireTransfer.

Postal code associated with the bank account. If the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to DirectDeposit or WireTransfer, this field is required for the countries identified in "PostalCode Field" on page 111. Optional for all other countries. Must be blank if the @type attribute on the AccountsPayable element is set to Check or Credit.
